review.method: the acceptance suite run locally with `CS_GAME_DIR` and `CS_ENGINE_IMAGE` set, every `accept_t541_` test selected by prefix with `--include-ignored`; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, the binding census the retail test derived over that installation and the mechanism record the image test derived over the owner-supplied decrypted executable, and a second full production re-run of the measured chain inside the harness itself (`decode_interp`, `discover_view_controls`, `horizon_bindings`, `read_gamez_nodes` over the eight world-group `gamez.zbd` archives, `load_engine_image`, `mechanism_source` and the instruction byte pins), which re-derives twenty declared bindings (sixteen `all_axes` `horizon` anchors and four `keep_own_height` anchors — `zone2_cloud_floor` and `moon_reflection` twice each), the `horizon` object3d under `world1` in every world group with the zone-sky containers as children, and the apply routine's five-call target list rather than trusting the log; both artifacts are checked against this report's own tree and hashes before they are referenced, so a stale file cannot be reported as this run's. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED: `retail` is read access to original files and byte inspection of the owner-supplied decrypted executable is static analysis — neither is a run of the original; where the original's runtime name registry resolves `zone2_cloud_floor` and `moon_reflection` from is unrecorded (the names are not stored nodes in any world-group `gamez.zbd`); whether the original's renderer draws the anchored subtrees exactly at the written translation each pass is unrecorded runtime behavior. `claim` is `implemented` only. `candidate_tree` is the tree of the commit the suite ran on; the only later delta is this report's own copy under docs/findings/evidence/, whose bytes are that file.
